assumptions.deltaCommonAttribution: Parent/group profit ratio used as an allocation proxy, not proven ownership of each adjustment. Existing printed employee funds remain deducted. Unestimated MBB/SSI funds receive a separate assumed haircut.
assumptions.cashConversionMeaning: After maintenance and normal working-capital drag, before separately deducted growth investment. Rates are assumptions, not measured maintenance capex.
assumptions.discountMeaning: Diagnostic hurdle sensitivity; 12% bull is not authorization for a normal BUY hurdle exception.
assumptions.terminalMeaning: Five explicit years; long-run growth falls to 1/2/2.5%, capped by year-five growth. Constant terminal ROE requires retained book growth in RIM.
assumptions.sourceVintage: Each observed balance retains its own source context; FY2025 comparative balances from H1 2026 are not spliced into original audited balance sheets.
assumptions.badDebtRecoveryMeaning: Two-year recovery mean times scenario factor; gross recovery expenses retained as reported, collection costs not separately allocated. Not a full recovery cycle.
